policy: Only assets with an explicit CC0/public-domain grant or a clearly compatible permissive license may be imported. Preserve source provenance. Never treat a static image or a color-swapped image as a completed animation sheet or a unique authored character.

sources.title: Free CC0 Fantasy Monster Sprites: Slime, Mushroom, Goblin, Golem
sources.creator: SpriteCanvas
sources.integrationNote: Strong technical candidate for Phaser because the pack provides real animation sheets and atlas metadata. Do not map a monster to an existing approved character until its appearance is inspected against that character's approved concept.

sources.title: Crypt Platformer Enemy Assets
sources.creator: IsabellaP
sources.integrationNote: Useful movement/attack references, but do not claim all characters have complete idle, hit, attack and defeat coverage without checking the actual sheets.

sources.title: Animated Monsters
sources.creator: stealthix
sources.integrationNote: Pixel-art style and character concepts need a visual fit review before any mapping into the existing 32 approved identities.

sources.title: Monster Builder Pack
sources.creator: Kenney
sources.integrationNote: Useful for assembling distinct visual accessories or concepts, but it is a modular static parts pack and is not itself an animation sheet.

sources.title: Abstract Platformer
sources.creator: Kenney
sources.integrationNote: Useful as a possible source of simple environment props, but the visual style and static enemy images do not satisfy the approved character animation requirement.

nonGoals: Do not add or activate the 29 excluded legacy enemy concepts.
Do not replace the 16 approved base enemy identities with unrelated creatures.
Do not replace the five approved boss identities with unrelated boss designs.
Do not download or use packs whose licenses are unclear or non-commercial-only.
Do not treat generated recolors, CSS tints, or Phaser tweens as authored sprite-sheet frames.
